question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to improve water quality by safely reusing pollutants as resources in relation to environmental benefits?
data_point: ability of the product to improve water quality by safely reusing pollutants as resources
description: The ability of a product to improve water quality by safely reusing pollutants as resources is related to environmental benefits, as it contributes to the circular economy and reduces the environmental impact of waste disposal. This ability is part of the product's reusability and recyclability, which are important aspects of sustainable construction and product life cycle management. By safely reusing pollutants as resources, the product helps to minimize the generation of hazardous waste and promotes the sustainable sourcing of materials. This ability is also related to the product's upgradability and ease of maintenance, as it allows the product to be refurbished and reused, reducing the need for new products and the associated environmental impact. Overall, this ability contributes to the product's environmental performance and helps to achieve the environmental benefits outlined in the voluntary harmonised standards and common specifications.
